name: Webflow

prompts.text: List the draft items in the blog collection and when they were last edited.
Which pages on my site have no meta description?
Create a draft blog post in the CMS from these notes.

description: Webflow lets agents read and update sites, pages, and CMS collections in the Webflow workspaces the signed-in user authorizes. Each user signs in to their own Webflow account through the browser.
